# FabricOps Starter Kit documentation navigation

Use these pages in order. This file is a navigation surface for AI agents and documentation tooling; the linked pages own the product definition, workflow, and technical detail.

1. [Product overview](index.md): What FabricOps is, who it supports, what it includes, and where to go next.
2. [Architecture](architecture.md): Workspace architecture, Governance ↔ Engineering responsibilities, metadata handoffs, Production boundaries, and consumption.
3. [Engineering](engineering.md): Pipeline orchestration, Fabric stores, processing strategies, recovery, profiling and lineage.
4. [Governance](governance.md): Governance as Code, contract lifecycle, sensitive data, Data Quality and metadata reporting.
5. [Guided Demo](guided-demo.md): Canonical step-by-step execution order for what to create, configure, open, run, and inspect.
6. [Notebook Templates](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/tree/main/templates/notebooks): Notebook responsibilities, downloads, and implementation handoff.
7. [Metadata Reference](reference/metadata.md): Metadata table purposes, schemas, and ownership.
8. [DQ Rule Reference](reference/dq-rules.md): Supported data-quality rule types and parameters.
9. [Function Reference](reference.md): Public callable behaviour and implementation detail.
10. [Maintainer documentation](maintainer/index.md): Release and repository maintenance guidance. The [Product Definition](maintainer/product-definition.md) owns canonical terminology, workflow, and product meaning.

The repository [README](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/README.md) provides repository-level orientation. The [Public API & Architecture guide](maintainer/public-api-architecture.md) documents the supported callable boundary and call-flow contracts.
